title: Saranagati: Hombale presents AI-motion-capture animated biopic of ISKCON founder Prabhupada, in theatres Aug 2027
headline: After ₹300 Cr Narsimha, Hombale Backs AI ISKCON Founder Biopic
caption:
Hombale Films, the studio behind KGF, Kantara and Salaar, will present and distribute Saranagati – The Life of a Surrendered Soul, an animated biopic of A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada, the founder of ISKCON. Its title teaser came out on 10 November.

The film follows Prabhupada's 1965 journey from India to the US, at 69, carrying the teachings of the Bhagavad Gita. Gaura Shakti Dasa writes and directs, and Transcendental Films produces it with Dive Deep AI Studio.

The makers call it a "hybrid AI" film. They say its characters are made with AI motion capture, which turns human movements and expressions into digital characters, and that its music and sound were made traditionally.

Saranagati is set to open in theatres worldwide in August 2027, timed to Prabhupada's Vyasa Puja, the makers say. Hombale also presented the animated Mahavatar Narsimha (2025), which grossed over ₹300 crore worldwide, according to trade trackers.

Would you buy a cinema ticket for a film animated with AI motion capture?

Sources: DNA India, ANI, The Hans India, Hombale Films, Sacnilk, Koimoi, Pinkvilla
